title: Random-oracle separation of PP from the QMA hierarchy

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard relativized quantum/classical/promise complexity models and imported Raz–Tal Forrelation, random-projection and query bounds
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Exact imported background statements and full original bibliography retained. Every source-local quantum simulation, concentration/restriction, oracle construction and diagonalization proof retained, including corrected v4 Lemma53.

core_obligations: Prove quantum/QMA-aware random-restriction simplification with the exact source parameters.
Iterate the simplification through circuits of QMA-query gates and derive the full parity-disagreement bound.
Translate the hierarchy oracle machine to a query circuit and prove PP is outside QMAH with probability one over the random oracle.
difficulty_reason: Non-routine quantum-aware random restrictions simplify circuits of QMA-query gates, leading to a parity disagreement bound and a probability-one random-oracle hierarchy separation. Complete restriction and diagonalization proofs are bundled with the advertised main result.
